project_type: React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Vite 5 single-page app backed by Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime). No own server. Plain CSS variables for all theming (NO Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS runtime).
build_system: Vite 5 + esbuild. A custom Vite plugin in vite.config.ts hooks transformIndexHtml and runs esbuild.build({ entryPoints:['src/lib/theme-core.ts'], bundle:true, format:'iife', globalName:'CBTheme', minify:true, write:false, platform:'browser', target:'es2018' }) to inline the pre-paint theme bootstrap into <head> before the app bundle. theme-core.ts MUST stay dependency-free (no React/Supabase/browser globals at module scope) so it bundles cleanly as an esbuild entry.
test_framework: Vitest + React Testing Library (jsdom environment). Pure functions (contrast math, auto-adjust, sorting, derivation, token resolution) get direct unit tests. RLS integration tests run against a real Supabase project when available; if no live backend in CI, ship a clearly-marked test harness + documented manual steps in SETUP.md.
build_command: npm run build  (tsc -b && vite build). Also run: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and npm run lint (eslint).

contribution_requirements: Components consume ONLY CSS tokens (var(--bg) etc.), never hardcoded colors. All write authorization is enforced server-side by Supabase RLS; the UI only hides controls as convenience, never as a security boundary. Every interactive element (schedule cell, add/remove/status buttons, theme controls, admin controls) is a real <button> with a visible :focus-visible ring using --focus-ring. .env is gitignored (already in .gitignore); .env.example is committed with placeholders. Pin exact dependency versions.
key_patterns: Pure domain logic lives in src/lib/ (theme-core.ts, contrast.ts, sorting.ts, derive.ts, types.ts) with no React/Supabase deps so it is directly unit-testable. Data access is three hooks (useSubjects/useScheduleSlots/useTasks) that fetch on mount regardless of auth and reconcile Realtime postgres_changes events by id (new payload for INSERT/UPDATE, old payload for DELETE — PK always present under default replica identity). Mutations in src/data/mutations.ts are thin wrappers that trust RLS, never a client role check. Dates (given_date, deadline) are Postgres date returned as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings and are compared lexicographically — NEVER passed through new Date(); today comes from localTodayISO() using local getters with getMonth()+1 and zero-padding (never toISOString()). Glow is DERIVED from the live tasks array (subjectHasPending), never stored. No optimistic UI for writes.
